messages:
hanna_cs: Quick signal — collected short verbatims from 4 onboarding calls and 2 renewal check-ins. Common theme: feature discoverability (users ask for 'route presets' + clearer defaults) and a small cluster asking for scheduled invoice previews. Two accounts marked renewal-risk. Want a capture flow that also auto-summarizes the verbatim into a 1-line problem and suggests priority.

 sam_enable: Love this. If the capture can produce a 1-sentence summary and a 'why now' field for enablement notes that'd speed our handoff.

 evan_product: We can try an NLP-assisted summary step in the modal: raw quote -> system-generated one-liner + confidence score. Fields: org, contact, account age, verbatim, auto-summary, impact estimate, frequency, suggested priority. If confidence < 0.6, show edit box.

 rachel_eng: For triage attach: deployment type, top-3 routes used, sample request id, and whether the account uses caching or dedicated pools. I can add a diagnostic flag to the webhook to pull a 24h usage snapshot when account id provided.

 hanna_cs: Draft modal copy pasted:

 ```
 Customer (org + contact):
 Account age (days):
 Verbatim (paste quote):
 Auto-summary (editable):
 Impact estimate: cosmetic / functional / blocking
 Frequency: once / occasional / every session
 Product area: console / billing / routes / docs
 Deployment (opt): Hosted / Dedicated / Private
 Sample request id (opt):
 Attachments: screenshot / link
 Suggested priority: low / medium / high
 ``` 

 sam_enable: I'll include a short note in the enablement playbook showing the modal and the 'edit summary' flow. Also add a checklist before sending to product: reproduce? yes/no, customer willing for a call? yes/no.

 evan_product: We'll create a tracker label 'cs-quick-snippet' and a triage slot on Friday. If we hit 5+ similar captures in two weeks we escalate to a UX pass.

 capture_bot: New capture created: SNIP-2026-711 "Route presets requested by multiple new accounts" submitted by hanna_cs. Link: https://tracker.internal/SNIP-2026-711

 rachel_eng: I'll prototype the shortcut + NLP summary lambda tonight. @hanna_cs can you DM a sanitized verbatim so I can tune the extractor?

 hanna_cs: Sent three sanitized quotes in DM. Thanks team — aiming to have the modal live for tomorrow's onboarding cohort. :rocket:
